pairs: Filii estote Domini Dei vestri: non vos incidetis,
“Be sons of the Lord your God. You shall not cut yourselves,
nor make yourselves bald, because of the dead.
quoniam populus sanctus es Domino Deo tuo,
For you are a holy people, for the Lord your God.
et te elegit ut sis ei in populum peculiarem de cunctis gentibus,
And he chose you, so that you may be a people particularly his,
out of all the nations on earth.
You shall not eat the things that are unclean.
Hoc est animal quod comedere debetis:
These are the animals which you ought to eat:
the stag and the roe deer,
Omne animal, quod in duas partes findit ungulam, et ruminat,
Every beast which has a hoof divided into two parts and which also chews the cud,
But those which chew over again,
but do not have a divided hoof,
you must not eat, such as the camel,
hæc, quia ruminant et non dividunt ungulam,
Since these chew the cud, but do not have a divided the hoof,
they shall be unclean to you.
since it has a divided hoof,
but does not chew over again,
Their flesh shall not be eaten,
and you shall not touch their carcasses.
Hæc comedetis ex omnibus quæ morantur in aquis:
These you shall eat out of all that dwells in the waters:
quæ absque pinnulis et squamis sunt,
Whatever is without fins and scales,
All the clean birds, you shall eat.
You shall not eat those that are unclean:
ixion et vulturem ac milvum juxta genus suum:
the crane, and the vulture, and the kite, according to their kind,
and the hawk, according to their kind,
likewise the crested hoopoe and the bat.
Et omne quod reptat et pennulas habet,
and also has little wings shall be unclean,
But whatever has died of itself,
you shall not eat from it.
quia tu populus sanctus Domini Dei tui es.
For you are the holy people of the Lord your God.
Non coques hædum in lacte matris suæ.
You shall not boil a young goat in the milk of his mother.
Decimam partem separabis de cunctis fructibus tuis qui nascuntur in terra per annos singulos,
Each year, you shall separate the tithes out of all your crops which spring forth from the earth.
et comedes in conspectu Domini Dei tui in loco quem elegerit,
And you shall eat these in the sight of the Lord your God, in the place which he will choose,
ut in eo nomen illius invocetur,
so that his name may be invoked there:
decimam frumenti tui, et vini, et olei,
the tenth part of your grain and wine and oil,
et primogenita de armentis et ovibus tuis:
and the firstborn from the herds and your sheep.
ut discas timere Dominum Deum tuum omni tempore.
So may you learn to fear the Lord your God at all times.
et locus quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus,
and the place which the Lord your God will have chosen is further away,
and he will have blessed you,
nec potueris ad eum hæc cuncta portare,
so that you are not able to carry all these things to it,
so as to turn them into money,
and you shall carry it in your hand,
et proficisceris ad locum quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus:
and you shall set out for the place which the Lord will choose.
et emes ex eadem pecunia quidquid tibi placuerit,
And you shall buy with the same money whatever pleases you,
either from the herds or from the sheep,
and all that your soul desires.
et omne quod desiderat anima tua:
And you shall eat in the sight of the Lord your God,
et comedes coram Domino Deo tuo,
et epulaberis tu et domus tua:
et Levites qui intra portas tuas est,
As for the Levite, who is within your gates,
take care that you do not abandon him,
quia non habet aliam partem in possessione tua.
for he has no other portion within your possession.
Anno tertio separabis aliam decimam ex omnibus quæ nascuntur tibi eo tempore,
In the third year, you shall separate another tenth part of all the things which spring forth for you at that time,
and you shall store it within your gates.
Venietque Levites qui aliam non habet partem nec possessionem tecum,
et peregrinus ac pupillus et vidua,
who has no other portion or possession with you,
and the sojourner as well as the orphan and the widow who are within your gates,
shall approach and eat and be satisfied,
ut benedicat tibi Dominus Deus tuus in cunctis operibus manuum tuarum quæ feceris.
so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands which you shall do.”
